range_interpretation: Source approximate regional halocline depth band,not one paired current thickness,annual range,confidence interval or velocity boundary.

source_definition: Author-reported approximate depth interval of the NCC-associated halocline. A hydrographic interface,not a measured velocity-zero boundary,current thickness,seabed or full-current bottom.
